moments.title: Happy 47th, Pink!
moments.blurb: Pop-rock powerhouse Pink, known for hits like 'Get the Party Started' and 'So What', celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Party Starter
angles.copy: Three-time Grammy winner Pink turns 47 on Tuesday! Which of her iconic anthems gets the party started for you?

angles.name: Iconic Pink
angles.copy: From 'Lady Marmalade' to 'Cover Me In Sunshine', Pink has given us so many unforgettable tracks. Wishing a huge happy 47th birthday to the incredible artist!

moments.title: Michael Bublé turns 51!
moments.blurb: The Canadian crooner and multiple Grammy winner, Michael Bublé, celebrates his 51st birthday on September 9th.

angles.name: Smooth Sounds
angles.copy: Feeling good! The one and only Michael Bublé celebrates his 51st birthday this Wednesday. What's your favourite smooth track from him?

angles.name: Birthday Crooner
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the king of modern-day crooners! Michael Bublé is 51 on September 9th. Which of his songs always makes you smile?

moments.title: Richard Ashcroft's 55th
moments.blurb: The Verve frontman and solo artist Richard Ashcroft, known for 'Bitter Sweet Symphony', celebrates his 55th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: The 'Mad Richard' himself, Richard Ashcroft, turns 55 this Friday! What's your ultimate Verve or solo track from him?

angles.name: Bittersweet Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the legendary Richard Ashcroft on September 11th. From 'Urban Hymns' to his solo work, a true British music icon.

moments.title: Harry Connick Jr. turns 59
moments.blurb: American singer, pianist, and actor Harry Connick Jr., famous for his jazz and big band sound, celebrates his 59th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Jazz Master
angles.copy: Happy 59th birthday to the multi-talented Harry Connick Jr. on Friday! His voice and piano skills are simply timeless.

angles.name: Big Band Birthday
angles.copy: From New Orleans jazz to Hollywood, Harry Connick Jr. has done it all. Wishing him a very happy 59th birthday this week!

moments.title: Moby celebrates 61
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Moby, known for global hits like 'Porcelain' and 'Natural Blues', celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Electronic Legend
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the iconic Moby this Friday! Which of his tracks takes you back to the golden age of electronic music?

angles.name: Moby's Hits
angles.copy: From 'Play' to '18', Moby defined a sound for a generation. Wishing a fantastic 61st birthday to the legend on September 11th!

moments.title: Jennifer Hudson turns 45
moments.blurb: EGOT winner and powerhouse vocalist Jennifer Hudson, known for 'Dreamgirls' and her solo career, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 12th.

angles.name: Powerhouse Voice
angles.copy: Happy 45th birthday to the incredible Jennifer Hudson this Saturday! An EGOT winner with a voice that truly soars.

angles.name: Dreamgirl Birthday
angles.copy: From American Idol to Oscar winner, Jennifer Hudson continues to inspire. Wishing a very happy 45th birthday to the phenomenal talent on September 12th!

moments.title: Peter Cetera's 82nd
moments.blurb: Former Chicago frontman and solo artist Peter Cetera, known for 'If You Leave Me Now' and 'Glory of Love', celebrates his 82nd birthday on September 13th.

angles.name: Chicago Legend
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to Peter Cetera on Sunday! The iconic voice of Chicago and a brilliant solo artist.

angles.name: Soft Rock Star
angles.copy: From 'Glory of Love' to 'The Next Time I Fall', Peter Cetera's ballads are timeless. Wishing a huge 82nd birthday to the legend on September 13th!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart #1
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart was updated yesterday, with 'Starlight' by Nova Pulse taking the top spot, making it their second number one hit.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: The Official UK Singles Chart updated yesterday and we have a new #1! Nova Pulse's 'Starlight' shines bright at the top. What do you think of the new chart-topper?

angles.name: Nova Pulse at #1
angles.copy: Congratulations to Nova Pulse on their second UK #1 with 'Starlight'! Have you heard it yet? Is it a worthy chart champion?

moments.title: Strictly fever grips UK
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is back on screens, bringing glitter and glamour to Saturday nights across the nation.

angles.name: Strictly Saturday
angles.copy: It's Saturday night, which means Strictly Come Dancing is back! Who are you rooting for in this year's competition?

angles.name: Glitterball Race
angles.copy: The battle for the Glitterball Trophy has officially begun! What's been your favourite dance so far in the new series of Strictly?

moments.title: Bake Off is back!
moments.blurb: The new series of The Great British Bake Off has returned, delighting viewers with a fresh batch of amateur bakers and signature bakes.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is back and we're already craving cake. What's your top bake for the week?

angles.name: Star Baker Watch
angles.copy: Who's going to be Star Baker this week on GBBO? The tent is open, and the competition is heating up!

moments.title: Autumn is here!
moments.blurb: As September progresses, the UK is fully embracing the sights, sounds, and flavours of autumn.

angles.name: Autumn Vibes
angles.copy: Crisp air, golden leaves, and pumpkin spice everything! Autumn is well and truly here. What's your favourite thing about the season?

angles.name: Cosy Season
angles.copy: Hello, cosy season! As the days get shorter, it's time for warm drinks, comfy blankets, and all things autumn. What are your plans for a perfect autumnal weekend?
